address: Plaza San Pedro Nolasco 5, Saragossa, 50001, Spain
bio: Intimate, personal and well run by a couple who have been trained in some of Spain’s leading restaurants. Maite’s updated take on traditional dishes is showcased on a concise à la carte plus a tasting menu, with lots of attention to presentation and respect shown to classic recipes that are not easy to find these days, such as sole meunière....
